commercial_assessment.assessment_scope: E-commerce Campaign / 服饰生活方式广告。服饰生活方式广告：强调真人、摄影、材质、氛围与点击动机；不要求价格或促销文案，促销层级与无文字画面的信息可读性可标 NOT_APPLICABLE。

evidence: Trench coat occupies ~60% of frame vertically and is centrally composed
Contrast between cream coat and dark skirt enhances visual separation
Handbag held at waist level draws attention without dominating
product_prominence.summary: Product is dominant yet balanced; clear focus on outerwear as hero item.

evidence: Wide lapel, belted waist, and structured shoulders highlight design features
Fabric drape and collar shape convey premium tailoring
No competing text or graphics distract from garment details
selling_point_clarity.summary: Key design elements (silhouette, structure, texture) are visually emphasized.

promotion_hierarchy.summary: No promotional text or hierarchy required per lifestyle campaign scope.

information_legibility.summary: No text present; not required for this ad type.

evidence: Model’s direct gaze and open posture create engagement
Clean, aspirational setting implies lifestyle desirability
Coordinated outfit (coat + skirt + shoes + bag) suggests complete look inspiration
click_motivation.summary: Strong emotional and aesthetic appeal likely to drive user interest and click-through.

evidence: Vertical framing suitable for Instagram feed and Pinterest
Minimal background ensures adaptability across mobile/desktop banners
High-key lighting maintains visibility on bright UI backgrounds
channel_placement_fit.summary: Composition aligns well with e-commerce lifestyle placements requiring elegance and clarity.

commercial_strengths: Exceptional material fidelity and lighting realism
Strong product prominence with elegant styling
Model expression and pose enhance relatability and aspiration
relative_gaps: Slight overexposure on left sleeve edge may reduce texture detail in print reproduction
commercial_assessment.summary: High-quality lifestyle image meeting all core requirements: authentic human presence, photorealistic execution, clear product focus, and strong commercial appeal without needing text.
